function.name: generate_line_chart_slide_2
function.description:
Generates a modern, data-driven Line Chart slide with a refined Global Economy aesthetic.
The visual style emphasizes structured analytical storytelling, combining clean typography, The slide layout is divided into three main sections:
- Upper section: reserved for main title and subtitle positioned on the right side.
- Left section: reserved for the line chart display with decorative circular shape and dot grid pattern.
- Right section: reserved for chart description, including textual content such as insights and interpretation.

The layout is designed to present visual data trends alongside supporting explanatory text in a modern Global Economy style.

main_title.description: Primary headline of the slide describing the overall evolution or trend displayed in the line chart (10–60 characters). The title should communicate insight or direction, not just restate the metric name. Example: Improvement of Model Accuracy During Training

subtitle.description: Contextual information that frames the chart, such as model type, dataset, training duration, or experimental setting. This helps the audience understand where and how the time-series data was produced. Example: CNN trained on Image Classification Dataset (50 Epochs)
subtitle.title: Subtitle

insight.description: A short analytical takeaway highlighting key patterns in the data, such as convergence speed, stabilization, divergence between series, or signs of overfitting. This field should explain why the trend matters rather than repeating values. x_axis.description: Label for the X-axis (time progression). Example: Epoch.

unit.description: Unit suffix appended to values when labels are shown. Example: %.

show_value.description: Whether to display numeric labels on chart points.
show_value.title: Show Value

Nội dung thô của tài liệu: "Chiến dịch Điện Biên Phủ năm 1954 là đỉnh cao của cuộc kháng chiến chống thực dân Pháp của quân và dân Việt Nam dưới sự lãnh đạo của Đảng và Chủ tịch Hồ Chí Minh, mà trực tiếp là Đại tướng Võ Nguyên Giáp. function.name: generate_line_chart_slide_2
function.description:
Generates a modern, data-driven Line Chart slide with a refined Global Economy aesthetic.
The visual style emphasizes structured analytical storytelling, combining clean typography, The slide layout is divided into three main sections:
- Upper section: reserved for main title and subtitle positioned on the right side.
- Left section: reserved for the line chart display with decorative circular shape and dot grid pattern.
- Right section: reserved for chart description, including textual content such as insights and interpretation.

main_title.description: Primary headline of the slide describing the overall evolution or trend displayed in the line chart (10–60 characters). The title should communicate insight or direction, not just restate the metric name. Example: Improvement of Model Accuracy During Training

subtitle.title: Subtitle

insight.description: A short analytical takeaway highlighting key patterns in the data, such as convergence speed, stabilization, divergence between series, or signs of overfitting. This field should explain why the trend matters rather than repeating values. Example: Training accuracy rises steadily, while validation accuracy plateaus after Epoch 20, suggesting mild overfitting.

x_axis.description: Label for the X-axis (time progression). Example: Epoch.

unit.description: Unit suffix appended to values when labels are shown. Example: %.

show_value.title: Show Value

show_legend.title: Show Legend

colors.title: Colors

Generates a clean and modern Bar Chart slide with a refined, presentation-ready aesthetic.
Visual style emphasizes clarity and balance, using soft accent colors and readable typography.
Layout:
- Upper section: Prominent main title with optional subtitle for context or units.
- Left section: Insight section highlighting key observations, accompanied by a clear legend.
- Right section: Structured SVG Grouped Bar Chart displayed inside a neat container.
Best suited for comparing multiple data series across shared categories in reports or business reviews.

main_title.description: Main title of the chart (10–60 characters). Example: Ocean Temperature vs. Depth Analysis
main_title.title: Main Title

subtitle.description: Subtitle, unit, or data source. Example: Data Source: Marine Institute 2025
subtitle.title: Subtitle

insight.description: Description or main insight of the slide. Example: Temperature drops steadily as depth increases in both oceans.
insight.title: Insight

x_axis.description: Label for the X-axis metric. Example: Ocean Depth (meters).
x_axis.title: X Axis

y_axis.description: Label for the Y-axis metric. Example: Average Temperature °C.
y_axis.title: Y Axis

unit.description: Unit suffix used for values. Example: °C.
unit.title: Unit

show_value.description: Whether to show value labels on bars. Example: True.
show_value.title: Show Value

show_legend.description: Whether to show the legend panel. Example: True.
show_legend.title: Show Legend

y_axis_min.description: Minimum value for Y-axis scale. Example: 0.
y_axis_min.title: Y Axis Min

y_axis_max.description: Maximum value for Y-axis scale. Example: 30.
y_axis_max.title: Y Axis Max

data_label_format.description: Template format for data labels. Example: {value}°C.
data_label_format.title: Data Label Format

colors.description: Color palette for each bar series. Example: ['#00695C', '#26A69A'].
colors.title: Colors

background_color.description: Background color of the full slide. Example: #E0F7FA.
background_color.title: Background Color

insight_box_background_color.description: Background color for the insight box. Example: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5).
insight_box_background_color.title: Insight Box Background Color

chart_panel_background_color.description: Background color of the chart panel. Example: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6).
chart_panel_background_color.title: Chart Panel Background Color

series.description: List of bar chart series. Each series has 'name' and 'values'. Example: [{'name': 'Pacific Ocean', 'values': [28, 22, 18, 12, 5]}].
series.title: Series

accent_color.description: CSS accent color for decorative elements.
accent_color.title: Accent Color

main_title_color.description: CSS color for the main title.
main_title_color.title: Main Title Color

function.name: generate_pie_chart_slide_1
function.description:
The slide layout is divided into three main sections:
- Upper section: Displays a large, bold main title in Teal and a white subtitle.
- Left section: Contains a highlighted insight box with an accent border and a legend.
- Right section: Features a high-contrast SVG pie or donut chart.

main_title.description: Primary heading of the slide. Should clearly describe what the pie chart represents.
main_title.title: Main Title

subtitle.description: Secondary text displayed below the main title. Typically used for data source, timeframe, or additional context.
subtitle.title: Subtitle

insight.description: Short analytical takeaway or key message derived from the chart data. Should highlight the most important insight.
insight.title: Insight

chart_type.description: Type of chart: 'pie' (full) or 'donut' (ring-style with center space).
chart_type.title: Chart Type

unit.description: Unit of measurement for the values (e.g., %, $, users). This may be displayed in labels or legends.
unit.title: Unit

show_value.description: Controls whether numeric values are displayed directly on the pie chart slices.
show_value.title: Show Value

show_legend.description: Controls whether the legend (mapping colors to labels) is displayed on the slide.
show_legend.title: Show Legend

data_label_format.description: Template string for formatting data labels on the chart. Use placeholders like {value}, {label}, or {unit}.
data_label_format.title: Data Label Format

colors.description: List of colors for pie chart slices. Each color corresponds to an item in 'items' by index order.
colors.title: Colors

items.description: List of data points for the pie chart. Each item must be an object with 'label' (string) and 'value' (number). Example: {"label": "AI Services", "value": 45}
items.title: Items

accent_color.description: Primary accent color used for highlights and borders.
accent_color.title: Accent Color

main_title_color.description: Color of the main title.
main_title_color.title: Main Title Color

background_color.description: Background color of the slide.
background_color.title: Background Color

function.name: generate_line_chart_slide_2
function.description:
Generates a modern, data-driven Line Chart slide with a refined Global Economy aesthetic.
The visual style emphasizes structured analytical storytelling, combining clean typography, The slide layout is divided into three main sections:
- Upper section: reserved for main title and subtitle positioned on the right side.
- Left section: reserved for the line chart display with decorative circular shape and dot grid pattern.
- Right section: reserved for chart description, including textual content such as insights and interpretation.

The layout is designed to present visual data trends alongside supporting explanatory text in a modern Global Economy style.

main_title.description: Primary headline of the slide describing the overall evolution or trend displayed in the line chart (10–60 characters). The title should communicate insight or direction, not just restate the metric name. Example: Improvement of Model Accuracy During Training
main_title.title: Main Title

subtitle.description: Contextual information that frames the chart, such as model type, dataset, training duration, or experimental setting. This helps the audience understand where and how the time-series data was produced. Example: CNN trained on Image Classification Dataset (50 Epochs)
subtitle.title: Subtitle

insight.description: A short analytical takeaway highlighting key patterns in the data, such as convergence speed, stabilization, divergence between series, or signs of overfitting. This field should explain why the trend matters rather than repeating values. Example: Training accuracy rises steadily, while validation accuracy plateaus after Epoch 20, suggesting mild overfitting.
insight.title: Insight

x_axis.description: Label for the X-axis (time progression). Example: Epoch.
x_axis.title: X Axis

y_axis.description: Label for the Y-axis metric being measured. Example: Accuracy.
y_axis.title: Y Axis

unit.description: Unit suffix appended to values when labels are shown. Example: %.
unit.title: Unit

show_value.description: Whether to display numeric labels on chart points.
show_value.title: Show Value

show_legend.description: Whether to display chart legend for multiple series.
show_legend.title: Show Legend

y_axis_min.description: Minimum Y-axis value used for chart scaling.
y_axis_min.title: Y Axis Min

y_axis_max.description: Maximum Y-axis value used for chart scaling.
y_axis_max.title: Y Axis Max

data_label_format.description: Optional formatting template for value labels. Example: {value}% or {value} pts.
data_label_format.title: Data Label Format

colors.description: Color list used for each line series in order.
colors.title: Colors

time_points.description: Ordered labels along the X-axis representing time progression. Example: ['Epoch 1', 'Epoch 5', 'Epoch 10', 'Epoch 15', 'Epoch 20', 'Epoch 25', 'Epoch 30'].
time_points.title: Time Points

series.description: Series data for the line chart. Each object should include 'name' and 'values'. Example: [{'name': 'Training Accuracy', 'values': [45, 62, 75, 84, 90, 94, 97]}, {'name': 'Validation Accuracy', 'values': [43, 60, 73, 82, 87, 88, 88]}].
series.title: Series

font_family.description: Main font family used across the slide.
font_family.title: Font Family

accent_color.description: Primary accent color used for highlights, markers, or emphasis elements. This color should complement the line colors while maintaining visual balance.
accent_color.title: Accent Color

main_title_color.description: Text color for the main title, chosen to create strong visual hierarchy and immediately communicate the slide’s key message.
main_title_color.title: Main Title Color

subtitle_color.description: Color applied to subtitle text, intentionally softer than the main title to provide context without competing for attention.
subtitle_color.title: Subtitle Color

insight_text_color.description: Color used for the insight section, optimized for comfortable reading of analytical commentary beneath the chart.
insight_text_color.title: Insight Text Color

body_background_color.description: Background color of the slide body.
body_background_color.title: Body Background Color

left_shape_background_color.description: Background color of the decorative left circular shape.
left_shape_background_color.title: Left Shape Background Color

right_panel_background_color.description: Background color of the right chart panel.
right_panel_background_color.title: Right Panel Background Color

insight_background_color.description: Background color of the insight card.
insight_background_color.title: Insight Background Color

Nội dung thô của tài liệu: "Quần thể di tích Cố đô Huế, tọa lạc bên bờ sông Hương thơ mộng, là minh chứng lịch sử hùng hồn cho triều đại phong kiến cuối cùng của Việt Nam - triều Nguyễn (1802-1945). function.name: generate_line_chart_slide_2
function.description:
Generates a modern, data-driven Line Chart slide with a refined Global Economy aesthetic.
The visual style emphasizes structured analytical storytelling, combining clean typography, The slide layout is divided into three main sections:
- Upper section: reserved for main title and subtitle positioned on the right side.
- Left section: reserved for the line chart display with decorative circular shape and dot grid pattern.

subtitle.title: Subtitle

insight.description: A short analytical takeaway highlighting key patterns in the data, such as convergence speed, stabilization, divergence between series, or signs of overfitting. This field should explain why the trend matters rather than repeating values. Example: Training accuracy rises steadily, while validation accuracy plateaus after Epoch 20, suggesting mild overfitting.

function.name: generate_line_chart_slide_2
function.description:
Generates a modern, data-driven Line Chart slide with a refined Global Economy aesthetic.
The visual style emphasizes structured analytical storytelling, combining clean typography, The slide layout is divided into three main sections:
- Upper section: reserved for main title and subtitle positioned on the right side.
- Left section: reserved for the line chart display with decorative circular shape and dot grid pattern.
- Right section: reserved for chart description, including textual content such as insights and interpretation.

main_title.description: Primary headline of the slide describing the overall evolution or trend displayed in the line chart (10–60 characters). The title should communicate insight or direction, not just restate the metric name. Example: Improvement of Model Accuracy During Training

subtitle.description: Contextual information that frames the chart, such as model type, dataset, training duration, or experimental setting. This helps the audience understand where and how the time-series data was produced. Example: CNN trained on Image Classification Dataset (50 Epochs)

insight.description: A short analytical takeaway highlighting key patterns in the data, such as convergence speed, stabilization, divergence between series, or signs of overfitting. Example: Training accuracy rises steadily, while validation accuracy plateaus after Epoch 20, suggesting mild overfitting.

unit.description: Unit suffix appended to values when labels are shown. Example: %.

function.name: generate_line_chart_slide_2
function.description:
Generates a modern, data-driven Line Chart slide with a refined Global Economy aesthetic.
The visual style emphasizes structured analytical storytelling, combining clean typography, The slide layout is divided into three main sections:
- Upper section: reserved for main title and subtitle positioned on the right side.
- Left section: reserved for the line chart display with decorative circular shape and dot grid pattern.
- Right section: reserved for chart description, including textual content such as insights and interpretation.

The layout is designed to present visual data trends alongside supporting explanatory text in a modern Global Economy style.

main_title.description: Primary headline of the slide describing the overall evolution or trend displayed in the line chart (10–60 characters). The title should communicate insight or direction, not just restate the metric name. Example: Improvement of Model Accuracy During Training

subtitle.description: Contextual information that frames the chart, such as model type, dataset, training duration, or experimental setting. This helps the audience understand where and how the time-series data was produced. Example: CNN trained on Image Classification Dataset (50 Epochs)
subtitle.title: Subtitle

insight.description: A short analytical takeaway highlighting key patterns in the data, such as convergence speed, stabilization, divergence between series, or signs of overfitting. This field should explain why the trend matters rather than repeating values. Example: Training accuracy rises steadily, while validation accuracy plateaus after Epoch 20, suggesting mild overfitting.

unit.description: Unit suffix appended to values when labels are shown. Example: %.

show_legend.description: Whether to display chart legend for multiple series.

function.description: Generates a minimalist and modern Icon List Slide featuring a grid-based layout with a distinct title column on the left and a vertical list of points on the right. You are a slide layout generator. Based on the slide content, the available layout tool schemas, and the style context of the previous slide, generate the optimal tool call in JSON format.
Your goal is to maintain visual consistency (matching the color palette and design tone of the previous slide) while selecting the best tool layout for the new content.

[PREVIOUS SLIDE STYLE CONTEXT]
- Layout Category: LIST_TOOLS
- Primary Theme Color: #10B981
- Background Style: Dark background (#111827)
- Font Scale Multiplier: 1.0
- Padding/Margins: 1.5rem

[CURRENT SLIDE CONTENT]
Thiết kế slide phân tích và so sánh đối chiếu về Cố đô Huế - Dấu ấn vàng son của triều Nguyễn.

function.name: generate_comparison_slide
function.description: Generates a symmetrical Comparison Slide featuring two vertical content columns separated by a central dashed vertical divider. This layout integrates two distinct SVG icons (defaulting to gavel and scales) centered above paired headings and descriptive body text. Ideal for Pros and Cons analysis, Legal or Ethical comparisons, and "Before vs. After" scenarios where a balanced visual weight between two opposing or complementary concepts is essential.
